Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: hand-stamp-raised.png, frame 1 MASTER REFERENCE for a frame-by-frame web animation. Generate exactly one 2048 x 2048 square PNG image, full bleed.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat solid neutral mid-gray RGB(127,127,127), hex #7f7f7f. Isolated subject on this gray. No paper or other props visible in this hand asset. Absolutely no cast shadow, contact shadow, gradient, vignette or background texture; shadows will be added in code.
Subject: a single REAL human RIGHT hand of an adult, natural light skin tone, authentic skin pores, subtle fine hair, normal short unpolished fingernails, wearing a rolled-up light-blue cotton shirt sleeve. The right hand holds a classic warm natural wooden office rubber stamp by its round turned wooden knob, relaxed grip. Stamp has a rectangular wooden base, realistic size about 7 x 3 cm, smoothly rounded corners, natural wood grain, plain unbranded handle. The base faces DOWN and is level, held slightly above the invisible surface. Red rubber stamping face is underneath and must NOT be visible.
Camera/composition: strict top-down flat lay; camera optical axis exactly perpendicular to surface, orthographic appearance, no perspective tilt. CRITICAL: the geometric center of the stamp's RECTANGULAR BASE is exactly x=35% of canvas width and y=35% of canvas height (x=716.8, y=716.8 on 2048 square). The base long edges run horizontally, with approx 500px width and 214px height. Knob centered on base. Some of the base can be naturally occluded by the fingers; enough of the perimeter is visible to read the rectangle. Hand and forearm run diagonally from the stamp toward the LOWER-RIGHT CORNER, where the forearm/sleeve is cropped by the image edges. Hand is proportionate to this 7cm stamp, forearm diagonal at about 45 degrees. Keep large clean gray negative space at upper right and lower left. Single hand only, anatomically correct five digits, with natural occlusion.
Lighting: soft diffuse daylight from upper left, neutral white balance, subtle shading on the hand and wood itself for realism, but NO shadow anywhere on the gray background. Sharp focus everywhere.
Text: absolutely none.
Avoid: text, letters, words, numbers, watermark, logo, jewelry, ring, nail polish, tattoo, extra fingers, missing fingers, deformed hand, two hands, cartoon, illustration, 3D render, perspective tilt, depth of field, blur, harsh shadows, cast shadow, colored light, vignette.

Use case: identity-preserve. Input image 1 is the MASTER REFERENCE hand-stamp-raised frame. Create ONE photorealistic 2048x2048 square PNG animation frame hand-stamp-pressing.png.
Change ONLY the pose to the firm down-press phase: same right hand now squeezes the same wooden round knob a little tighter, fingers curl naturally, knuckles subtly tense, wrist bends a little lower, rectangular wooden stamp base level and flat on the invisible surface. Movement is small and plausible; this is the next frame of the same shot.
LOCK INVARIANTS: identical adult person, natural light skin tone and fine hairs, anatomically correct five-digit right hand, same rolled-up light blue cotton sleeve and folds, same honey-colored wood grain and stamp construction, rectangular wooden base about 7x3 cm with horizontal long edges. Same scale, top-down orthographic camera, image crop, forearm diagonal to and cropped by the lower-right corner. Same soft diffuse upper-left daylight and neutral white balance, sharp everywhere.
REGISTRATION: keep rectangular stamp base centered at exactly 35% from left and 35% from top, x=716.8 y=716.8 on 2048x2048. Keep apparent base size, angle and position locked to image 1. Red rubber face remains underneath and invisible.
BACKGROUND: perfectly uniform solid neutral gray #7f7f7f, including immediately around the subject. NO cast shadows or contact shadows, no vignette, no paper, no imprint, no other objects. Only intrinsic soft shading on the subject itself.
Avoid: text, letters, words, numbers, watermark, logo, jewelry, ring, nail polish, tattoo, extra fingers, missing fingers, deformed hand, two hands, cartoon, illustration, 3d render, camera perspective tilt, depth of field, blur, harsh shadows, cast shadow, colored light, vignette. No multi-panel output.

Use case: product-mockup. Asset: stamp-imprint-frame.png, ONE 2048x1024 PNG, horizontal 2:1 canvas.
Photorealistic top-down scan-like photograph of a single fresh red rubber stamp imprint on plain bright white paper. Nothing else. Centered horizontally and vertically with ample white margins, imprint approx 75% of image width and 55% of image height. The imprint is a wide rectangle with gently rounded corners, made of a thick OUTER border and a thin INNER border, separated by a narrow white gap. Inner space is entirely EMPTY white paper: absolutely NO text, symbols, logos or graphics. The entire rectangle is intact and easy to recognize, not distressed to illegibility. Plain white paper fills the whole canvas with extremely subtle realistic fibers; no paper edges, no desk visible.
Camera exactly straight down orthographic, sharp focus, even neutral soft light, no cast shadows.
